text:
Ivy Park: Quick design check — in the new dashboard the compact button cluster looks cramped next to the table filters. Also a toast overlaps the sticky header when the list is scrolled. Screenshot: https://redwood-assets.example/compact-cluster-toast.png :eyes:

Noah S.: Repro. Spacing token `--space-1` is being reused for button gaps; we should introduce `--button-gap-sm` so toolbar buttons don't inherit list spacing. Toast is mounted inside the table and gets clipped by the header (stacking context issue).

design-bot: Suggested tokens/snippet:
```
--button-gap-sm: var(--space-2);
--toast-offset-top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-3));
--toast-z-index: 1100;
```
Portal to root and position: fixed recommended.

Rae (a11y): Two a11y nits: 1) ghost button focus on dark surfaces is 1px and hard to see — increase to 2px; 2) toasts reading just "Saved" are ambiguous in multi-panel consoles. Prefer templated announcements like "{entity} saved" with fallback "Changes saved" and `role=status aria-live=polite`.

Ivy Park: Agree on tokens. Can we also ensure button hit targets don't shrink under compact density? Touch teams need >=44px. Maybe `--button-min-hit: 44px` and override density when `surface=touch`.

Ethan M.: I'll open a small PR on `ui/ux-fixes` to: 1) add `--button-gap-sm` and `--button-min-hit`, 2) portal toasts to root with top offset token + z-index, 3) increase ghost focus to 2px on dark surfaces, and 4) update toast SR copy pattern. Will include storybook snapshots for dense table + toolbar. ETA today. :thumbsup:

Noah S.: For z-index ordering: lowering toast to 1100 is fine so menus at 1250/1300 still float above. Also add `pointer-events: none` to toast wrapper so it doesn't block clicks on mobile.

Rae (a11y): Add an axe check to storybook that asserts `aria-live` present and that the message isn't exactly "Saved". Also include keyboard focus snapshot.

Ivy Park: Thanks — please include a short migration note in the component docs so teams know about the new tokens and the legacy inline toast alias.

Ethan M.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/948 — contains tokens, portal change, tests, and a small migration note in docs. Requesting reviews from Rae and Ivy.

Ivy Park: Reviewing now. If visual diffs look good let's ship in the next patch release. :shipit:
